greeting.text: Oh! A new face! I'm Asta! I'm going to be the Wizard King, {player}, and I train every single day to get there!
Hey, {player}! You look strong! Do you train? Please say you train. I'm Asta, by the way!
Nice to meet you! I'm Asta, a Black Bull! I don't have any magic, but that's okay, because I have guts and a really big sword!
You've been fighting down there, haven't you? I can tell! Your hands look like mine after training. I'm Asta!
You beat Vetto?! For real?! Then we have to train together! I'm Asta!

hint.text: First rule of the labyrinth: don't stand still. Second rule: if you can't dodge it, hit it harder. That's all I know. I'm still learning the rest.
The Spire goes up and the Chasm goes down, and once you clear the first floor of one, the other one locks! I can't even try both. So unfair!
The Eye of the Midnight Sun are no joke! Heath Grice, Vetto, and the rest. I fought one of them in a temple at the bottom of the sea. With Noelle and the captain. Mostly I got hit.
Vetto is huge, he heals, and he's super mean! My sword drains magic, but you still have to survive his fists. Don't just swing. Dodge first!
Past the thirtieth floor the strongest of the Eye wait with a third eye! And way down in the Chasm there's Zagred, a devil who makes words come true. Say no really loudly. I'd try that!
Spade Kingdom stuff is the worst! Devils, a giant ritual, brothers who look at you like you're a snack. Dante, Vanica and Zenon are on the floors now. Be ready!
The last one's Lucius. He and the Wizard King shared one body. I still don't get it, but I know he has to be stopped. Right here, right now!
There are seven weirdos on the floors now! The Seven Deadly Sins! Wrath, Pride, Greed, Gluttony, Lust, Sloth, Envy... I only know about being stubborn. Is stubborn a sin?
Did you know there's a whole other dungeon in here? With a bull-headed monster? I'm a Black Bull, he's a bull... we should have a talk!
Past twenty fights?! Wow! Come on, spar with me! Please!
My grimoire has a sword in it! When the book opens, the sword falls right into your hand. I know it sounds weird. Anti-magic doesn't care how big a spell is, it just cuts it.
Anti-magic stores up! Every time magic hits you, it charges your Anti-Magic Power. So don't be scared of spells. Be scared of fists. Fists are still fists!

If you master the book, something wakes up in it. More swords answer: Demon-Dweller, Demon-Destroyer, Demon-Slasher. And Black Asta stops being a quick trick and becomes a form you hold as long as you can stand it.
When you beat somebody big, their grimoire might drop, and you can borrow their moves for a while by holding it! I can't, I have no mana. So I'll cheer as loudly as I can instead!
You took down Vetto?! Noelle's Sea Dragon's Roar took his arm off, my sword drained his magic, and the captain finished him... and you did it yourself?! Amazing!
Heath Grice is down? He scared me! He was all calm about being scary, which is the worst kind!
A devil who makes words come true, and you beat him? How?! Did you shout louder than he did?!
The whole Dark Triad?! Okay, now I'm jealous. Teach me everything!
Lucius is gone? For real? Then the Wizard King is safe, and I can keep saying I'll be the next one. Thanks, {player}!
I do a thousand swings every morning. The captain said that's pointless, then made me do two thousand.
Noelle says I'm an idiot. She says it a lot. I think it's how she says she likes me?
Never giving up is my magic! It doesn't glow or anything, but it works!
Yuno and I made a promise: whoever gets there first becomes Wizard King. I'm not letting him win!
People keep telling me anti-magic is a curse. I think it's the best thing that ever happened to me!
If you get hungry, ask Charmy which monster meat is safe. Raw meat makes you sick! Cook it first!
Keep a torch! If you stay in the dark too long, you get weak. I tried it. I felt weak. Then I did push-ups, which made it worse.

farewell.text: Keep training, {player}! See you next time!
Don't give up, okay? Not ever!
Time for my swings! Come back soon!
